assertions.name: the all-pairs geometric coupling conserves energy inviscidly for every lam (per-pair pairing is exact; drift is RK2 only)
assertions.source: nu=0 short run, relative energy drift < 1e-4

assertions.name: the all-source per-amplitude equilibrium holds along actual trajectories at every (lam, eps): r_n = sup u_n * nu*k_n / sum_{m<n} lam^{n-1-m} (sup u_m)^2 <= 1 on every excited empty-start rung — the per-amplitude route survives ALL-PAIRS nonlocality with decay as weak as lam = 0.9
assertions.source: max r_n per (lam, eps) over empty-start rungs

assertions.name: the dissipation-scale crossing B* still exists at every (lam, eps) and its physical wavenumber still decreases with eps
assertions.source: theta_n profile per rung; k_phys(B*) monotone in eps within each lam

description: SF9 (bean qou-p0be): all-pairs nonlocality stress test for the per-amplitude route (PRs #5066, #5072). Couples EVERY rung pair (m < n) with geometric weight lam^{n-m-1}, each pair energy-conserving by construction; the geometric structure telescopes into O(N) forward/backward recursions so no coupling truncation is needed. Measures the all-source trajectory equilibrium ratio and the dissipation-scale crossing across lam in {0.5, 0.9} and eps. lam = 0.9 is far more delocalized than NS triad decay. Scope (a); float64 RK2 exploratory tier; sweeping effects (phase decorrelation by large scales) are not representable in a real-amplitude shell model and remain the irreducible caveat.
